title: Strait of Hormuz shipping grinds to a halt ahead of U.S.-Iran ceasefire expiry
summary_full: Shipping traffic in the Strait of Hormuz sank to a new low as a ceasefire between the U.S. and Iran is set to expire on Monday with no deal in sight.
